scenario: Single-homed null-ESI AC-to-AC move of same MAC (.601 -> .602)
expected: UPDATE_LOCAL: MAC + MAC-IP owner interface follow the host; Sequence number NOT bumped (no seq line for the host MAC); no Mobility History block; mac-table suppress empty; mac-mobility-redis-count stays 0.
anti_pattern: Reporting moved=0 / seq=0 as a bug. It is CORRECT for null-ESI AC-to-AC. Do NOT open a defect.

scenario: Distinct-ESI AC-to-AC move of same MAC (.602 ESI-B -> .601 ESI-A)
expected: MOVE_LOCAL_TO_LOCAL (counted): Sequence number 0->1; MAC Mobility 'Moves per Detection Window' = 1; Mobility History block (Local <ac1> #seq0 -> Local <ac2> #seq1); mac-mobility-redis-count 0->2.
anti_pattern: Expecting the counter to move for a null-ESI setup. Counting requires an ESI/path-type change.

scenario: IP vs MAC move counter on the first counted move
expected: MAC 'Moves per Detection Window' = 1 while IP 'Moves per Detection Window' = 0, even though IP Sequence bumped to 1 and IP Mobility History recorded the move.
anti_pattern: Treating the IP window-counter lag as MAC/IP inconsistency without noting the IP Sequence + IP Mobility History DID update.
